assets.title: Panorama kota dunia
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a finished, extra-wide 3:1 panoramic background image for the hero header of a light-theme global air quality website.
Primary request: an elegant international city panorama under one expansive shared sky, immediately conveying a worldwide outlook.
Scene/backdrop: a single continuous, artfully imagined world waterfront with subtle architectural silhouettes evoking New York, London, Paris, Dubai, Shanghai and Sydney. Interpret the architecture as a sophisticated editorial landscape, not a literal geographically real city or a travel-poster collage. Small distinctive forms, believable proportions, layered distance, open water, a little greenery, flowing soft atmospheric clouds.
Style/medium: refined contemporary editorial illustration with subtle matte paper texture, delicately modeled atmospheric depth, restrained details and beautiful soft edges. Polished and distinctive, not childish clip art or an infographic.
Composition/framing: very wide horizontal 3:1 banner, approximately 2400 by 800. The left 50 percent and upper-left must be predominantly calm pale sky with extremely low contrast, leaving generous clean negative space for a large black HTML heading and supporting copy. Most architectural detail sits across the lower-right half; a low horizon and clouds lead the eye toward the cities. Keep subjects within the middle vertical area so shallow header cropping remains useful.
Lighting/mood: fresh clear morning, welcoming, quietly optimistic, a feeling of breathing room.
Color palette: match an existing light interface with sky #d3e3fd, off-white #f8fafd and blue #a8c7fa; small subdued sage accents and very restrained warm morning highlights.
Constraints: image only, edge-to-edge artwork, no text, no lettering, no labels, no logos, no flags, no watermark, no UI elements, no frame. No Indonesian-specific landmarks or local village scenery. Air and atmosphere must remain the visual focus. This is conceptual artwork, do not represent air-quality measurements or imply actual live data.

assets.title: Bumi dan Atmosfer
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a finished, extra-wide 3:1 panoramic hero background for a premium light-theme global air quality dashboard.
Primary request: the luminous curve of Earth and its delicate shared atmosphere, a beautiful universal image of the air connecting all places.
Scene/backdrop: a highly realistic Earth horizon viewed from very high altitude, sweeping ocean blue, natural white cloud systems, subtle distant green land texture, and a thin physically plausible atmospheric glow. Earth occupies the lower-right half and extends off the bottom-right edges. It is a close planetary horizon rather than a small floating globe.
Style/medium: cinematic photorealistic environmental visualization, editorial science-cover quality, realistic clouds and refined natural atmospheric scattering. A soft artistic fade of the upper scene into a luminous pale-blue field is intentional so it works in a light user interface.
Composition/framing: extra-wide horizontal 3:1 image, approximately 2400 by 800. Keep left 50 percent as clean, pale ice-blue negative space for dark HTML heading and copy. The atmospheric curve rises gently toward the right; captivating globe detail on the right, open soft sky on the left. Wide quiet composition suitable for shallow banner cropping.
Lighting/mood: gentle dawn sunlight grazing the atmosphere, expansive, peaceful, sophisticated, hopeful.
Color palette: icy pale blue #d3e3fd and off-white at left, ocean azure and subtle emerald at right, clean white clouds; highlights controlled so no hard glare.
Constraints: image only, no text, no labels, no borders, no maps with political boundaries, no data overlays, no glowing data connections, no digital grids, no satellites, no spaceships, no fake metrics, no logos, no watermark, no stars or black space background. No isolated spherical planet against a flat background. This is illustrative imagery, not an actual satellite observation.

assets.title: Cakrawala Dunia
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: a finished, extra-wide 3:1 panoramic background photograph-style image for a global air quality website hero.
Primary request: a breathtaking but believable international waterfront metropolis where city, greenery and open air meet.
Scene/backdrop: an imagined contemporary coastal city viewed from an elevated position across a broad calm harbor. Layered modern glass towers and midrise buildings on the right, mature urban tree canopy, a gently curving green waterfront park, distant blue ridges and open water. Globally recognizable urban character without representing a specific country or relying on named local landmarks.
Style/medium: photorealistic premium architectural and environmental editorial photography, natural glass reflections, real leaf texture, credible building geometry, subtle photographic grain, a 35mm wide landscape lens. Timeless real-world urban atmosphere rather than a science-fiction eco-city render.
Composition/framing: extra-wide horizontal 3:1 panorama, approximately 2400 by 800, low horizon. The left 50 percent is luminous pale blue open sky and hazy water with very low contrast, suitable behind a large dark HTML heading and supporting copy. The strongest city forms stay in the lower-right half. A few very soft cloud forms and natural atmospheric perspective, no large foreground object or person. Broad composition, not a busy aerial street grid.
Lighting/mood: fresh early morning light after rain, clear breathable atmosphere, inviting, calm and international.
Color palette: pale sky blue #d3e3fd, muted cool glass blue, soft emerald and sage greenery, restrained golden reflections. Harmonize with a clean light blue and white dashboard.
Constraints: no text, no lettering, no signs, no logos, no flags, no watermark, no UI, no frames. No Indonesian landmarks, no tropical village cues, no dystopian pollution, no giant futuristic towers, no fantasy architecture. Avoid oversaturation and stock-photo HDR. The scene is conceptual and must not display or imply specific live air-quality readings.
